Hi Maria / Tessa,

Attached are the items requested:

1) subprocessor_roster_20270509.csv — roster with vendor name, country, processing purpose, and S3 bucket/endpoint types
2) Redwood_DPA_signed_20270509.pdf — countersigned DPA including the Data Processing Addendum and standard SCCs Appendix
3) dataflow_diagram_scandia_v1.png — simplified dataflow showing processing hops

Key notes:
- Onward transfers: We do engage a downstream analytics vendor (VectorBridge Analytics, US) for quality monitoring of model outputs. Customer content is pseudonymized before it is sent for analytics; no raw PII is included in those payloads.
- Legal basis for transfer: SCCs (EU Commission standard contractual clauses) are in place between Redwood and VectorBridge; copies are attached. VectorBridge acts as a subprocessors and is bound by our DPA.
- Subprocessors in roster include: Amazon Web Services (EU regions), Google Cloud Platform (multi-region), VectorBridge Analytics (US; analytics), Securilog Monitoring (US; logs). Where subprocessor is US-based, SCCs have been signed and are appended to the DPA.
- Data retention: analytics-derived logs are retained for up to 90 days for monitoring and debugging; customer content retention follows the customer-configured retention policy (see DPA).

If you need an exec summary for your DPO that explicitly states 'Redwood has executed SCCs with all non-EU subprocessors and requires the same from downstream processors' I can prepare one.
